content_sections.heading: About IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: This research project operates under the Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, with sponsorship from the Armament Research Board, DRDO, Delhi. The appointed Junior Research Fellow will support systematic experimental investigations into the structural behaviour of unaged and aged sandwich composites for armament applications. Selected candidates will get an opportunity to pursue a PhD once the project is over (PhD candidate will be given MHRD fellowship as per Institute Policy).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position must meet the following educational qualifications: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engg./Production Engg./Aerospace Engg./Equivalent. ME/M.Tech in Machine Design/Applied Mechanics/Aerospace Engg./Equivalent. GATE qualified candidates will be preferred. content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The project aims at a systematic investigation of the structural behaviour of unaged and aged sandwich composites for armament applications. A systematic experimental approach will be employed to characterize Nomex, PMI foam, and PVC foam core sandwich composites. Hygroscopically aged specimens will be evaluated to verify moisture resistance and its detrimental effect on the mechanical properties. Delamination behavior will be examined under Mode-I and Mode-II loading for both aged and unaged samples. The fatigue performance of various aged sandwich composite samples will be assessed and benchmarked against unaged Nomex, PMI and PVC core-based sandwich composites.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit their applications with the following documents to the office of Principal Investigator through email as a Single PDF file in the following order: Application in a plain paper with detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained. Experience including research, industrial field and others. Attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. Submit the application via email to the Principal Investigator (Prof. Indra Vir Singh) at [email protected] or [email protected] by November 15, 2026, by 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position. Only the shortlisted candidates will be notified through email for interview. The interview will be held online through Webex or Google Meet.

faq.question: Q1. What is the position offered in the IIT Roorkee recruitment notification SRIC/06?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q2. Who is the sponsoring agency for this research project?
faq.answer: The project is sponsored by the Armament Research Board, DRDO, Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly emolument for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Tech. in Mechanical Engg./Production Engg./Aerospace Engg./Equivalent and an ME/M.Tech in Machine Design/Applied Mechanics/Aerospace Engg./Equivalent. GATE qualified candidates are preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email to the Principal Investigator is November 15, 2026, by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q6. How will the interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: Interviews will be held online through Webex or Google Meet, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email.

faq.question: Q7. Can selected candidates pursue a PhD after the project?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates will get an opportunity to pursue a PhD once the project is over, and PhD candidates will be given MHRD fellowship as per Institute policy.

faq.question: Q8. How should the application documents be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to the Principal Investigator as a single PDF file containing an application on plain paper, a detailed CV, experience details, and attested copies of certificates in that order.
